turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Hello, mrs. Martinez. Good to see you today.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Hey, dr. Gomez.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Hey, dragon, I'm here seeing mrs. Martinez. She's a 43-year-old female. Why are we seeing you today?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, my arm hurts right here. Kind of toward my wrist. This part of my arm.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: So you have pain in your distal radius?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yes.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: How did that happen?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, I was playing tennis, and when I went to hit, um, I was given a, a backhand, and when I did, I m- totally missed the ball, hit the top of the net but the pole part. And, and it just jarred my arm.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay. And did it swell up at all? Or-

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: It did. It got a... It had a little bit of swelling. Not a lot.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay. And, um, did, uh, do you have any numbness in your hand at all? Or any pain when you move your wrist?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: A little bit when I move my wrist. Um, no numbness in my hand.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay. Do you have any past medical history of anything?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, yes. Allergic, um, l- I have allergies. And so I take flonase.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay. And any surgeries in the past?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yes. I actually had a trauma of, um, a stabbing of, um... I actually fell doing lawn work-

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: On my rake.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: I was wondering where you were going to go with that.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay. Great. So, let's take a look at, uh, the x-ray of your arm. Hey dragon, let's see the x-ray. Okay, looking at your x-ray, I don't see any fractures, uh, don't really see any abnormalities at all. It looks essentially normal. Great. Let me examine you.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Okay.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Does it hurt when I press on your arm here?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yes.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay. How about when I bend your arm?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yes.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay. That's pretty tender,?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Mm-hmm.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: How about when I go backwards like that?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Not as much.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And how about when I flex like this?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: A little.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: But mostly when I do that type of motion?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yes.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, great. So, um, you have pain following hitting your arm on the net. On your exam, you definitely have some tenderness over your distal radius, um, on your arm. You have pain when I stress especially your thumb, and, and flex your thumb. So, I think what you have is basically just a strain and maybe a contusion to that muscle, from hitting it. Um, you certainly don't have a fracture. I think at this point, we're really going to treat it actually conservatively. We'll have you use ice, um, uh, for the, the pain and swelling. And some anti inflammatory. Um, what we'll do is give you some motrin, 800 milligrams three times a day, with food. Um, if it doesn't get any better in the next week or so, let me know, and we'll take a look at you again.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Okay.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, great. Hey dragon, go ahead and order the procedures, and the medications as discussed. Why don't you come with me. Dragon you can finalize the note.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Thank you.
